description: Compare human HPO annotations for OMIM:619602 against MGI phenotypes of Atp1a2-null mice
code:
import requests, json, pandas as pd, numpy as np, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---- human HPO annotations for OMIM:619602 ----
h = requests.get("https://ontology.jax.org/api/network/annotation/OMIM:619602", timeout=90).json()
hpo=[]
for cat, items in (h.get("categories") or {}).items():
    for it in items:
        hpo.append({"hpo":it["id"],"term":it["name"],"freq":(it.get("metadata") or {}).get("frequency","")})
if not hpo:
    for it in h.get("annotations",[]) or []:
        hpo.append({"hpo":it["id"],"term":it["name"],"freq":""})
H=pd.DataFrame(hpo).drop_duplicates("hpo")
print("Human HPO terms, OMIM:619602  n =", len(H))
print(H.to_string(index=False))

# ---- mouse homozygous-null phenotypes (MGI, Atp1a2 tm1Kwk / tm2Kwk) ----
mouse_hom = ["neonatal lethality, complete penetrance","respiratory failure","no spontaneous movement",
             "unresponsive to tactile stimuli","increased gamma-aminobutyric acid level",
             "abnormal synaptic neurotransmitter level","abnormal action potential",
             "abnormal nervous system electrophysiology","abnormal somatic nervous system physiology",
             "abnormal amygdala morphology","abnormal olfactory cortex morphology"]
print("\nMouse Atp1a2-null phenotypes n =", len(mouse_hom))

# ---- manual concordance mapping (human HPO -> mouse MP counterpart) ----
conc = {
 "Fetal akinesia sequence":"no spontaneous movement / unresponsive to tactile stimuli",
 "Decreased fetal movement":"no spontaneous movement",
 "Akinesia":"no spontaneous movement",
 "Neonatal death":"neonatal lethality, complete penetrance",
 "Death in infancy":"neonatal lethality, complete penetrance",
 "Respiratory insufficiency":"respiratory failure",
 "Neonatal respiratory distress":"respiratory failure",
 "Apnea":"respiratory failure",
 "Seizure":"abnormal action potential / abnormal nervous system electrophysiology",
 "Abnormal cortical gyration":"",
 "Polymicrogyria":"",
 "Microcephaly":"",
 "Arthrogryposis multiplex congenita":"",
 "Hydrops fetalis":"",
 "Polyhydramnios":"",
}
H["mouse_counterpart"]=[conc.get(t,"") for t in H["term"]]
mapped=int((H["mouse_counterpart"]!="").sum())
print(f"\nConcordance: {mapped}/{len(H)} human HPO terms have a documented MGI counterpart "
      f"in Atp1a2-null mice ({100*mapped/len(H):.0f}%)")
print(H[["term","mouse_counterpart"]].to_string(index=False))

# ---- figure ----
H2=H.sort_values("mouse_counterpart",ascending=False)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,0.42*len(H2)+1.8))
cols=["#2a7f62" if m else "#b03a2e" for m in H2["mouse_counterpart"]]
ax.barh(range(len(H2)),[1]*len(H2),color=cols,height=0.72)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(H2))); ax.set_yticklabels(H2["term"],fontsize=9)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_xlim(0,1.0)
for i,(t,m) in enumerate(zip(H2["term"],H2["mouse_counterpart"])):
    ax.text(0.02,i, ("MGI: "+m) if m else "no mouse counterpart recorded",
            va="center",fontsize=8,color="white")
ax.set_title("ATP1A2 FARIMPD (OMIM:619602): human HPO terms recapitulated by Atp1a2-null mice\n"
             f"green = documented MGI phenotype ({mapped}/{len(H)}), red = not reported",fontsize=10)
for s in ("top","right","bottom","left"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
